verdict.rationale: Relay documents issuing virtual or physical Visa debit/credit cards with spend limits and role assignment (relay-docs-2, relay-docs-16, relay-docs-26), which supports scoping cards to team members or purposes, but there's no explicit documentation of instant creation, per-vendor/single-merchant locking, or purpose-tagged card categories like 'ad spend'. missing for 10: explicit instant-issuance workflow, vendor/merchant-lock restriction, and named use-case templates (e.g., ad-spend cards) with independent confirmation.
